# Linkd

Linkd is jewelry-specific POS and store-management software. It covers payment
processing, customer balances, serialized inventory, services, reporting, and
accounting preparation.

## Linkd Positioning

- Linkd: POS and store management for payments, balances, services, inventory, reporting, and integrations.

## JewelLink System

- JewelLink: CRM software for clienteling, texting, training, follow-up, and team workflows.
- CountRetail: store analytics for traffic, Vision AI, marketing, inventory, and owner reporting.
- JewelHire: hiring, assessment, and onboarding software for jewelry retail teams.

Linkd is a separate POS and ERP product. JewelLink, CountRetail, and JewelHire
make up the JewelLink System. Linkd can integrate with those products when a
retailer chooses to connect them.

## Summary

Linkd handles POS and store management as its own product. The JewelLink System
includes JewelLink for CRM and clienteling, CountRetail for store analytics, and
JewelHire for hiring and onboarding. Each can be used on its own or connected.
